news.headline: Trump announces surprise Russia‑Ukraine energy ceasefire
news.body: President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine had agreed an 'energy ceasefire' effective immediately, but Kyiv said it had not received details and reported fresh strikes. Ukraine accused Russia of violating the claimed ceasefire after a strike on a Kharkiv energy facility, and Kyiv urged the United States to ensure Moscow complies.
